name: Garmin Connect MCP Assistant
summary: Explore your Garmin activities and wellness trends with a read-only AI companion. Compare sessions, preserve units and flag missing data. Requires your own configured Garmin Connect MCP server; no account access or hosting is included.
use_cases: Summarize recent activities using the fields Garmin actually returns
Compare swimming sessions without confusing moving pace and elapsed pace
Review dated steps, weight or sleep trends and disclose missing measurements
Inspect associated workouts without inventing performed strength sets
Troubleshoot a missing connector or distinguish status from authentication
needs_access_to: A separately installed, configured instance of graiola/garmin-connect-mcp connected to the same AI agent
The user's own Garmin account and Garmin Connect Personal API access
A supported Agensi agent connection when loading this skill through Agensi
compatibility_note: The connector requires Python 3.11+ on the user's host. Documented setup targets Linux/macOS. Local clients can use stdio; authenticated loopback HTTP is also implemented. The intended agent must support the chosen connection and separately connect to Agensi. Compatibility with individual third-party agents has not yet been established by a live end-to-end test.
permissions_note: The skill has no executable scripts or network client. It instructs the agent to use six read-only Garmin MCP tools. The separately operated connector contacts official Garmin endpoints. Garmin credentials stay on the connector host; returned data is processed by the connected AI service. Do not send measurements, credentials or activity notes to marketplace tools.
author: Gennaro Raiola
note: Local preparation metadata, not an Agensi API payload. Review the actual submission form and select Free manually. No price, paid service, affiliate enrolment or publication is authorized by this file.
